night_start.name: {name}
night_start.text: *Back in my room, I change out of my uniform and lie down.*

night_msg_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_3.text: I'll have drinks ready next time

night_msg_seo_5.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_5.text: *She sent 'On the house' as a separate message. Deliberately.*

night_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night_msg_yuna_1.text: It was nice having you there quietly today

night_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night_msg_yuna_2.text: I'll leave a seat for you tomorrow too

night_msg_yuna_3.name: {name}
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *While I reread “I'll save your seat,” the screen dims on its own.*

night_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_1.text: Didn’t think I’d lose at rock-paper-scissors

night_msg_dain_3.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_3.text: Still mad about paying for that bread today. Seriously.

night_msg_dain_4.name: {name}
night_msg_dain_4.text: *All three lines arrive almost at once. There's already a “lol” waiting in the reply box.*

night_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *There's a post from the homeroom teacher on the school app. 'Class 3-2 Notice: Bring math supplies for 1st period tomorrow. — And the transfer student only needs to keep settling in okay.'*

night_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *I reread the notice and put my phone face down.*

night_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_1.text: *A notification pops up from the school's health app. 'Nurse's office record: Transfer student — mild dizziness. Drink plenty of water today and don't skip breakfast. If the symptoms return, visit the nurse's office.'*

night_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_2.text: *After reading the instructions, I fill the bottle by my bed.*

night_late_transition.name: {name}
night_late_transition.text: *Just as I'm about to fall asleep, my phone buzzes again. Eleven at night. Who is it?*

night_seo_late_2.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_2.text: If you don't show, I'm coming to find you

night_seo_late_3.name: {name}
night_seo_late_3.text: *I put down the phone. The time I need to arrive at school tomorrow remains on the lock screen.*

night_yuna_late_1.name: Yuna
night_yuna_late_1.text: *A gray bubble reads “This message was deleted.”*

night_yuna_late_2.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_2.text: *The typing indicator appears and disappears. No new message.*

night_yuna_late_3.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_3.text: *I open and close the reply box until the screen sleeps.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_4.text: *Only my thumbprint remains on the black screen.*

night_dain_late_2.name: Dain
night_dain_late_2.text: Looking for someone to work out with tomorrow morning

night_dain_late_4.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4.text: *I've already typed 'I'm in' into the reply box.*

night_end_1.name: {name}
night_end_1.text: *I put down my phone and stare at the ceiling. The scent of cherry blossoms still lingers on my uniform.*

night_end_3.name: {name}
night_end_3.text: *I look at the saved names and turn off the screen.*

forced_violation_day1_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_after_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon speaks coldly after a silence.* Don't think you can pretend what you just did never happened. Don't come near me or contact me for a while.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's face stays tense.* I heard you. That doesn't erase what happened. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts the explanation short.* A misunderstanding? The moment I said no, it stopped being one. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day1_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_after_yuna.text: *Yuna catches her breath, wary.* You knew I didn't want it, and you ignored me. I don't even want to see your face right now. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_yuna_apologize.text: *Yuna answers after a long pause.* An apology doesn't make it disappear. Stop now.

forced_violation_day1_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna cuts off the explanation before it is finished.* I said no. There's nothing to explain.

forced_violation_day1_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_after_dain.text: *Dain doesn't smile. After a long pause, she answers briefly in a stiff voice.* This isn't a joke. I said no and you forced it anyway. I'm not letting this go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_dain_apologize.text: *Dain finally gives a short answer after a long pause.* Fine. Then we're done for today. I decide if and when we talk again.

forced_violation_day1_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough.* No. Don't make excuses. I said no, and you did it anyway.

forced_violation_day1_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_after_teacher.text: *The teacher speaks firmly.* What you just did clearly crossed a line. Do not come any closer. I will handle this through the proper procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_teacher_apologize.text: *The teacher takes a breath and speaks.* I heard your apology. I'll still follow the proper procedures. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day1_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher cuts off the explanation.* This is not the time to start explaining yourself. Stop talking and keep your distance.

forced_violation_day1_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_after_nurse.text: *The nurse's playfulness disappears.* Keep your distance from now on. I will document what happened and inform the people who need to know.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_nurse_apologize.text: *The nurse answers firmly after a pause.* I hear your apology. I'll still document this and notify the appropriate people. This conversation is over.

forced_violation_day1_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops lower.* Do you think calling it a misunderstanding changes anything? The fact is, you ignored me when I said no.
